Definition: a primary verb; to moisten (especially by a shower):--(send) rain, wash.
BiblicalUsage: In James we find bréchō, the word for to moisten, to send rain. Plainly used, and no mystery about what it means.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe bréchō is worth a moment of attention, and I think you will see why when you read the verse.
